description: A small light wooden case with an orange handle sits on the tabletop, and a yellow-and-black tape measure is brought into view. The right hand holds the tape measure and repeatedly pulls the yellow tape out and lays it across the case—first across the top surface, then diagonally and along the front edge near the latches—while the left hand steadies the case and pins the tape’s end in place before the right hand retracts and repositions it for another measurement.
